dct_title_s: Satellite detected water extents in Gaborone, South East Districts, Botswana as of 23 February 2025
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: FL20250220BWA, GDACS ID: 1103128** This map illustrates the satellite-detected accumulated flood extent in Gaborone, South East District, Botswana, as observed from Planet imagery acquired on 23 February 2025. Within the analyzed area of approximately 120 km², about 10 km² of land appears to be affected by floodwaters. UNITAR-UNOSAT has identified approximately 670 potentially affected structures within the analyzed area. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
